pick.name: Cloudflare Workers Logs
pick.why: Zero setup for the default stack; OTLP export to Grafana/Sentry/Axiom when you outgrow it
pick.free_limits: Free 200k log events/day, 3-day retention; Paid 20M/mo then $0.60/M, 7-day; pricing moves to 'Cloudflare Observability' on 2026-12-01

alts.name: Grafana Cloud Free
alts.why: Best free volume + open standards (OTel) for VM/containers
alts.free_limits: 50 GB logs, 50 GB traces, 10k metric series, 14-day retention, 3 users; 'Always free'; no commercial restriction stated

candidates.name: Grafana Cloud
candidates.verdict: Alt: once you run containers/VMs or need 14-day retention

candidates.name: Axiom Personal
candidates.verdict: 500 GB ingest/30 days but plan named 'Personal' for individuals/small projects; ToS not read

decision: Use what the platform gives you first; it costs nothing to wire. Add Grafana Cloud via OTLP when you have containers on Cloud Run/VM or need >3 days retention.
details: Cloudflare observability pricing changes 2026-12-01: re-check after that date.

verify.note: Workers Logs Free 200k events/day, 3-day retention; Paid 20M/mo + $0.60/M, 7 days; moves to Cloudflare Observability pricing from 2026-12-01. Grafana Free 50 GB logs/traces, 10k series, 14 days, 3 users; the page names 'early-stage startups' and states no commercial restriction.
